stories.story_fr: Programme de restructuration achevé : 886 M$ de charges totales pour ~775 M$ d'économies annuelles pérennes (rendement de 87%), créant la capacité d'investir pour accélérer les capacités de la banque.
stories.story_en: Restructuring program completed: $886MM total charges for ~$775MM fully realized annual cost savings (87% yield), creating capacity to invest and accelerate the bank's capabilities.
stories.quote: Total restructuring program charges of $886MM pre-tax ... Expect fully realized annual cost savings of ~$775MM pre-tax (87% savings yield)

stories.story_fr: Cible de 2 à 2,5 Mds$ d'économies annualisées à moyen terme via 6 initiatives dont l'automatisation et l'IA, la modernisation technologie et données, témoignant d'une discipline de coûts structurelle.
stories.story_en: Targeting ~$2-2.5B in annualized cost savings over the medium-term across 6 initiatives including Automation & AI, Technology & Data Modernization, evidencing structural cost discipline.
stories.quote: Targeting ~$2-2.5B in annualized cost savings over the medium-term, delivered across 6 key cost initiatives: (1) Distribution Transformation, (2) Automation & AI, (3) Technology & Data Modernization

stories.story_fr: La remédiation BSA/AML aux États-Unis déploie une nouvelle plateforme KYC stratégique et des modèles d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA spécialisée pour la détection des crimes financiers.
stories.story_en: U.S. BSA/AML remediation is deploying a new strategic KYC platform plus machine learning and specialized AI for financial crime detection.
stories.quote: Additional deployment of new Know Your Customer strategic platform ... Further deployments of machine learning and specialized AI

stories.story_fr: TD est la première institution financière à rejoindre OIN 2.0 (licences croisées de brevets sur IA, cybersécurité, cloud) et détient un portefeuille de 3 600 brevets, reflet d'un engagement long terme dans l'innovation.
stories.story_en: TD is the first FI to join OIN 2.0 (patent cross-licensing on AI, cyber, cloud) and holds a 3,600-asset patent portfolio, reflecting a long-term innovation commitment.
stories.quote: TD is the first FI to join leading companies as a funding member of OIN 2.0. ... TD's patent portfolio now includes 3,600 assets

stories.story_fr: L'engagement numérique progresse fortement : transactions TD MyInsurance +39% sur douze mois et clients assurance habitation/auto engagés numériquement en hausse de 730 points de base à 79,2%.
stories.story_en: Digital engagement rises sharply: TD MyInsurance transactions up 39% over twelve months and Home & Auto Insurance digitally engaged clients up 730 bps to 79.2%.
stories.quote: TD MyInsurance Transactions (millions) +39% ... Clients Digitally Engaged (% of total customers) +730 bps ... 79.2
